mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a political system where there are many political parties big and small contesting in an election with the motive of winning political power and subsequently governing the country."

A multi-party system is a political system where there are many political parties big and small contesting in an election with the motive of winning political power and subsequently governing the country.

Direct political socialisation is the process whereby individual directly and consciously learn the behavioural patterns of his community.

Institutional pressure groups are made up of legislatures, executive the civil servants and the judiciary.

Representation on the other hand is the process by which people are chosen to act on behalf of the community.

A political party is a platform or machinery for taking part in the struggle for power.

Lobbying means to try and influence a politician or the government, for example to persuade them to support or oppose a change in the law.

A pressure group is an organised social interest group formed solely to pursue its objectives/interest and influence government policies.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the political rights or privilege granted by the state to an individual to vote in an election or referendum."
Franchise is the political rights or privilege granted by the state to an individual to vote in an election or referendum.
